name: Mor'Ladim
summary: Mor'Ladim stalks the grounds of Raven Hill Cemetery in Duskwood, a vengeful skeletal warrior. He was once Morgan Ladimore, a noble knight who lost his family and was overcome by grief and madness, rising in undeath to kill those who cross his path.

sections.title: A Knight of the Silver Hand
sections.body: Before Raven Hill feared his name, Morgan Ladimore defended the helpless from Grand Hamlet, now called Darkshire. He married Lys at eighteen, and they raised three children in peace until war called him north. During the Third War, Morgan marched with Uther the Lightbringer to Lordaeron. There he witnessed the fall of the Knights of the Silver Hand, the spread of Kel'Thuzad's plague, and Uther's death.

sections.title: The Fall of Morgan Ladimore
sections.body: After the war, Morgan returned to a Duskwood darkened and a homestead in ruins. He searched among the headstones at Raven Hill Cemetery and found the graves of Lys and two of their children. Grief and fury overtook him, and he struck at the stones. When cemetery attendants tried to calm him, Morgan killed them in a blind frenzy. Clarity returned, and horror at what he had done drove him to plunge his own blade into his heart. Ashamed, the townsfolk buried him in a remote, unmarked corner of the cemetery.

sections.title: The Scourge of Raven Hill
sections.body: Morgan found no peace in the grave. Guilt over the innocent blood he had shed and suffocating grief stirred his corrupted remains from the earth as a hulking skeletal revenant. Travelers and the Night Watch soon learned to fear the name Mor'Ladim. With his ancestral blade Archeus, he patrols the misty graves, cutting down beasts and unwary travelers who stray near his resting place.

faq.answer: In life, Mor'Ladim was Morgan Ladimore, an honorable paladin and knight from Grand Hamlet. During the Third War, he fought alongside Uther the Lightbringer in Lordaeron.

Grief drove Morgan mad when he found his family's graves. After killing innocent cemetery attendants and taking his own life, guilt and anguish bound his soul to his body, raising him as a murderous undead warrior.
Mor'Ladim roams Raven Hill Cemetery in western Duskwood, patrolling its paths and mausoleums. His wide patrol route often catches travelers unaware.

faq.q: Did all of Morgan Ladimore's family die?
faq.answer: No. Lys and two of Morgan's children died, but their third child survived Duskwood's decline. Morgan never learned this in his despair at the graveyard.

faq.q: What is the weapon Mor'Ladim carries?
faq.answer: Mor'Ladim carries Archeus, the fine blade that served him as a knight in life and became his weapon in undeath.
Commander Althea Ebonlocke and the Night Watch of Darkshire seek Mor'Ladim's destruction to protect patrols and travelers from his ambushes in western Duskwood.

angles.text: As a paladin, you can see Morgan Ladimore was once an honorable warrior of the Light who fought alongside Uther the Lightbringer. His fall shows the danger of letting sorrow and wrath eclipse sacred vows.
As an Alliance member, you can see how the Third War shattered southern kingdoms like Stormwind. Morgan Ladimore returned from war to find his family and home ruined.
